note: Opponent pools. Steps are Manafold's power slider (forgesim/power.py): 0 B2 Low, 1 B2 Mid, 2 B2 High, 3 B3 Low, 4 B3 Mid, 5 B3 High, 6 B4 Low, 7 B4 Mid, 8 B4 High, 9 B5 cEDH.
window_note: default = Nick's pick on 2026-11-28: Bracket 2 High through Bracket 4 Mid (steps 2-7). Was B2 Mid to B3 High (1-5). Change the numbers here to move it.
chosen_note: Your chosen opponents (decks/chosen) skip the power window; about one table in chosen_one_in gets one of them (1 = every table). The sims page's Decks tab changes this number.
picks_note: Nick's picks (decks/picks) sit at every table when any exist: this many seats per game; rotation and gauntlet decks fill the rest.

rotation.size_note: 120 since 2026-11-28 (was 30), so the same few opponents don't meet over and over. pages = Archidekt search pages of 50 per bracket; per_commander = most decks one commander can have in the pool.
rotation.source: Archidekt public Commander decks, most viewed, with the owner's bracket set to one in 'brackets'; Archidekt deck tags give the plan
